intro.title: Ecash is a network of modern currency exchange offices
intro.text: We give you a ready-made solution for building a profitable business with full professional support

advantages.title: Modern technology and software
advantages.text: You get access to unique software that covers every aspect of running an exchange office — from transaction accounting to profit analysis.

advantages.title: Strong growth of loyal customers
advantages.text: Service quality and transparent operations — so important to our customers — make electronic money a market leader and ensure a steady flow of visitors.

advantages.title: Teamwork
advantages.text: We understand that opening a business takes teamwork. That is why we are always by your side: together we pick the best location, set up the processes and train the staff. We will grow and improve the business at every stage, working as one team.

advantages.title: A recognisable brand
advantages.text: Electronic money is the new standard in currency exchange. Reliability, security and service quality — principles proven over the years.

package.text: The Ecash franchise includes everything you need to launch your exchange office: from step-by-step instructions to automated business management solutions

items.title: Right to use the brand
items.text: The right to use the brand helps you attract more customers, raise awareness and reach profit faster.

items.title: Support in choosing a location
items.text: We help you pick the best location for your business — higher customer flow, convenient access and a favourable competitive environment.

items.title: Exchange office design and branding
items.text: We provide a complete brand book for your business: a distinctive identity, signage, logos and interior elements that highlight your brand.

items.title: Training for owners and staff
items.text: Our experts train you and your team, covering all key aspects of running the business, and arrange ongoing support.

items.title: A full set of documents and business processes
items.text: We provide ready instructions for organising the business, covering every stage: from opening an account to working effectively with customers and staff.

items.title: Access to unique software
items.text: You get access to unique software that handles currency operations, transaction tracking and end-to-end reporting.

steps.text: Opening your business with Ecash is transparent and simple. We support you at every stage so you start earning sooner.

items.title: Submit a request through the form on the site
items.text: Start with a simple step — fill in the form on our website with basic information about yourself and your interest in the franchise.

items.title: Have an interview and clarify the details
items.text: We discuss your plans, opportunities and expectations. You also receive full information about the franchise and the terms of cooperation.

items.title: Sign the partnership agreement
items.text: Once all terms are agreed, we draw up the official contract that secures your right to operate under the Ecash brand.

items.title: Choose a location with our help
items.text: We help you pick the right place for the exchange office, with analysis of foot traffic, the competitive environment and customer convenience.

items.title: Complete the training and set up processes
items.text: Before you start, you and your team go through full training, including legal, operational and marketing aspects.

items.title: Start earning
items.text: After the preparation we open the exchange office together with you, set up marketing and organise the first working processes.

contact.text: Opening your business with Ecash is transparent and simple. We support you at every stage so you start earning sooner.

support.title: Support for partners
support.text: We work to keep your business growing steadily and efficiently, providing resources, tools and help at every stage.

items.title: Consulting on any question
items.text: Our specialists are available at every stage — from choosing a location to serving your first customers. We respond quickly and look at your case individually.

items.title: Staff training
items.text: We run regular training for cashiers and administrators: cash handling, security procedures and Ecash customer-service standards.

items.title: Design and renovation of premises
items.text: We help design the exchange office layout and find contractors for renovation — from floor planning to signage installation.

items.title: Accounting
items.text: We handle accounting and tax reporting for your exchange office, so you can focus on customers instead of paperwork.

items.title: Treasury
items.text: Ecash's centralised treasury sets your rates and arranges cash collection, taking currency risk off the partner's shoulders.

items.title: Equipment purchasing
items.text: Partners get help selecting and purchasing the equipment needed to run the exchange office.

items.title: Legal and technical matters
items.text: We support licensing and permit paperwork, and resolve technical matters — from cash-handling equipment to internet connectivity.

items.title: Marketing
items.text: We launch advertising campaigns for your opening and share the network's marketing materials — from signage to social media posts.

items.title: Regulator liaison and reporting
items.text: We prepare and file the mandatory reports to the National Bank and other regulators, so your exchange office always operates within the law.

items.title: HR
items.text: We help you find and hire cashiers and administrators: ready-made job profiles, contract templates and hiring guidance.

items.title: Cash collection and security
items.text: We arrange regular cash collection and connect your premises to security — alarm systems, video surveillance and a panic button.

items.title: Gold operations with the National Bank
items.text: We advise and work together with partners on gold operations with the National Bank.

items.q: How do I choose a suitable location?
items.a: We help you pick the right place for the exchange office, with analysis of foot traffic, the competitive environment and customer convenience.

items.q: How long does it take to open an exchange office?
items.a: It usually takes 1.5–3 months from application to opening — the timeline depends on finding premises and obtaining documents. We support you at every stage.
We look for partners with an entrepreneurial mindset who are ready to meet our standards. Business management experience is welcome, but we provide training and support even for newcomers.
